title: 3-Manifolds and 3d Indices
container-title: Advances in Theoretical and Mathematical Physics
note: arXiv:1112.5179, Adv. Theor. Math. Phys. 17 (2013) 975-1076. Added 2026-07-17 from library/arxiv-1112.5179v1/1112.5179v1.pdf. The DGG 3d-index: the tetrahedron index $I_\Delta(m,e)$ and the flux-sum gluing rule (§4.3) that assembles the total index of an ideal triangulation as a sum over internal edge-flux integers subject to the gluing equations — the derivation source for the integer Stokes / Donaldson–Thomas data behind the 1ppq $A_\omega$ target (G3 route, PR #3805/#3826), including the figure-eight m004 example.
